module: Manager of the vehicle's jbeam controllers (vehicle VM, global `controller`). On load, it reads the `controller` section of the jbeam (`v.data.controller`), loads each `lua/vehicle/controller/<fileName>.lua` file with `rerequire`, calls its `init(jbeamData)` then the stages `initSecondStage`, `initSounds`, `initLastStage`. It sorts the controllers (by rank of the powertrain device `relevantDevice`, then `manualOrder`, then `defaultOrder`, then name) and builds cached function lists to call all the `update`, `updateGFX`, `updateFixedStep`, etc. without a test every frame. A modder mainly uses it to find a controller (`controller.getController("name")`) or to load one on the fly (`loadControllerExternal`).
usage:
-- direct access (error if absent)
local esc = controller.getController("esc")
-- tolerant access: returns a 'nil' object that accepts any call
controller.getControllerSafe("jato").fire(true)
-- all controllers of a type
for _, c in ipairs(controller.getControllersByType("hydraulics/electricHydraulics")) do print(c.name) end
notes: Controller lifecycle: (1) init(jbeamData) on creation; (2) initSecondStage(jbeamData), initSounds(jbeamData), initLastStage(jbeamData) after the powertrain, electrics, etc. are ready; (3) every physics step `update(dt)` then `updateWheelsIntermediate(dt)`, an `updateFixedStep(dt)` at a fixed 100 Hz (1/100 s accumulator), every graphics frame `updateGFX(dt)`. The optional hooks are beamBroken, beamDeformed, nodeCollision, onCouplerFound, onCouplerAttached, onCouplerDetached, onGameplayEvent, debugDraw, settingsChanged, serialize/deserialize, getState/setState.

On reset: if the controller has no `reset`, `controller.reset` calls its `init` again; `resetSecondStage` calls `reset(jbeamData)` if it exists, otherwise `initSecondStage`; `resetLastStage` calls `resetLastStage()` otherwise `initLastStage`. `resetSounds` only calls `resetSounds()` if it exists.
Warning: the name of the break hook in controllers is `beamBroken` (this is what cacheControllerFunctions looks for), whereas the manager's function is called `controller.beamBroke`.

Controller without a standard `type`: `M.type = "main"` designates the main controller (only one; a second one replaces the first with a warning). If there is none, the `dummy` controller is added. A controller without a jbeam section also gets `dummy`.

The `shiftLogic-*` controllers (automaticGearbox, cvtGearbox, dctGearbox, manualGearbox, sequentialGearbox) are ignored (blacklist); a controller's default name is its fileName, so a unique `name` must be given to instantiate several of the same type.

Relocated controllers: registerRelocatedController keeps compatibility of the old names (vehicleController, AVAS, airbrakes, reverseWarn, adaptiveBrakeLights, brakedDifferentialSteering, compressionBrake, postCrashBrake, transbrake) with their new subfolders.

The fields update, updateGFX, updateWheelsIntermediate, beamBroke, beamDeformed, nodeCollision, onCouplerFound/Attached/Detached, onGameplayEvent and debugDraw are `nop` (empty function) as long as no controller has the corresponding function; they are therefore not nil. The fields mainController and nilController are nil at declaration and then filled by init().
Anomaly: the getControllerSafe logs for the relocated case announce `controller.getControllersByType` instead of `controller.getControllerSafe` (log message only).
The manager's onCouplerFound passes 4 arguments (including nodeDist) whereas controllerTemplate and the debug versions declare only 3.
If a hard-coded debug version (updateDebug, etc.) is uncommented at the top of the file, it replaces the loops; it must be generated with controller.printDebugMethodCalls() for the exact vehicle.

mainController.desc: Controller whose `type == "main"` (only one), or the `dummy` controller if none. nil before init().

isFrozen.desc: true if setFreeze(1) has been called.

nilController.desc: 'Null' object created by init(): any indexing or call returns itself, writing is ignored. Returned by getControllerSafe when the controller is not found.

update.desc: Calls update(dt) of each controller then, with the 100 Hz accumulator, updateFixedStep. Is nop if there is nothing to call. Called by the physics loop.

updateWheelsIntermediate.desc: Calls updateWheelsIntermediate(dt) on each relevant controller (intermediate physics step for the wheels).

updateGFX.desc: Calls updateGFX(dt) on each controller, once per graphics frame.

beamBroke.desc: Broadcasts beamBroken(id, energy) to the controllers that have it.

beamDeformed.desc: Broadcasts beamDeformed(id, ratio) to the controllers that have it.

nodeCollision.desc: Broadcasts nodeCollision(p) to the controllers that have it (p: parameter coming from the engine).

onCouplerAttached.desc: Broadcasts onCouplerAttached(nodeId, obj2id, obj2nodeId, attachSpeed, attachEnergy).

onGameplayEvent.desc: Broadcasts onGameplayEvent(eventName, ...) to the controllers that have it.

debugDraw.desc: Broadcasts debugDraw(focusPos) to the controllers that have it.

registerRelocatedController.desc: Declares that an old controller path/name is now at a new path, so that old jbeam files keep working.

newPath.desc: New path relative to the controller/ folder (e.g. "braking/transbrake"); for loadControllerExternal it is the full path without extension.

settingsChanged.desc: Calls `settingsChanged()` on each controller that defines it. Called when the game settings change.

getAllControllers.desc: Returns the actual table (not a copy) of all loaded controllers, keyed by name.

getController.desc: Returns the controller with this name, or nil if it does not exist (test before indexing, otherwise error).

name.desc: Controller name (by default the fileName, otherwise the jbeam `name` key).

getControllerSafe.desc: Like getController but never returns nil: handles relocated controllers and, if nothing is found, returns `nilController`, which accepts any index or call without error. Handy for calls like `controller.getControllerSafe("x").function()`.

getControllersByType.desc: Lists the controllers whose type (fileName) equals typeName, taking into account relocated controllers without a custom name.

getControllersFromPath.desc: Lists the controllers whose typeName starts with the given prefix (search by folder).

setFreeze.desc: Sets `isFrozen` to `mode == 1` and forwards the call to the main controller.

updateSimpleControlButtons.desc: Calls `updateSimpleControlButtons()` on each controller that has it (refreshes the UI's simplified control buttons).

loadControllerExternal.desc: Loads a controller on the fly, outside the jbeam. Refuses a name already taken and controllers of type `main`. Then calls init, initSecondStage, initSounds, initLastStage, re-sorts the controllers and rebuilds the call caches. Errors are logged without crashing.

controllerData.desc: Data passed to init as jbeamData; {} by default.

returns.desc: The loaded controller, nil on failure.

unloadControllerExternal.desc: Removes a loaded controller from the manager (without calling any cleanup function) and rebuilds the call caches.

init.desc: Loads all controllers from the jbeam (or dummy), creates the nilController, registers relocated controllers, skips the blacklist, merges the `v.data[name]` data with the declaration, calls `init(data)`, designates the main controller and sorts the controllers. A controller's errors are logged without blocking the others.

cacheAllControllerFunctions.desc: Rebuilds the function lists called by update, updateGFX, updateFixedStep, updateWheelsIntermediate and the hooks, based on the functions present on each sorted controller. To be called again if a controller dynamically adds or removes one of these functions (e.g. M.update = ...).

initSecondStage.desc: Calls `initSecondStage(jbeamData)` on each controller then rebuilds the caches. Called after the init of all the vehicle's systems.

initLastStage.desc: Calls `initLastStage(jbeamData)` on each controller then rebuilds the caches.

initSounds.desc: Calls `initSounds(jbeamData)` on each controller then rebuilds the caches.

reset.desc: Resets the fixed-step accumulator to 0 and calls `init(jbeamData)` again on controllers that have no `reset` function (those that have one are handled in resetSecondStage).

resetSecondStage.desc: For each controller: `reset(jbeamData)` if it exists, otherwise `initSecondStage(jbeamData)`; then rebuilds the caches.

resetLastStage.desc: For each controller: `resetLastStage()` if it exists, otherwise `initLastStage(jbeamData)`; then rebuilds the caches.

resetSounds.desc: Calls `resetSounds()` on the controllers that define it then rebuilds the caches.

printDebugMethodCalls.desc: Development tool: prints Lua code listing the direct calls (by sortedControllers index) to paste at the top of controller.lua to replace the loops.

onDeserialize.desc: Hook called when a saved state is reloaded: passes to each controller named in `data` its share via `deserialize(controllerData)`.

data.desc: controller name -> data previously returned by its serialize().

onSerialize.desc: Hook called on state save: collects `serialize()` from each controller that defines it.

setState.desc: Passes `data` to the `setState(data)` function of each controller that defines it.

data.desc: State to apply; nil does nothing.

getState.desc: Recursively merges the results of `getState()` from each controller that defines it.

isPhysicsStepUsed.desc: Indicates whether at least one controller needs the physics loop (update, updateFixedStep or updateWheelsIntermediate).

returns.desc: true if one of these hooks exists.
